question.problem:
Find the gradient of the product $f(x,y)h(x,y),$ given that 

$$
\begin{aligned}f(x,y) & =\operatorname{arctan}⁡(\frac{x}{y}),\, &  & ∇f(x,y)=\frac{y}{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}}\,i-\frac{x}{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}}\,j, &  &  \\ h(x,y) & =\sqrt{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}},\, &  & ∇h(x,y)=\frac{x}{\sqrt{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}}}\,i+\frac{y}{\sqrt{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}}}\,j. &  & \end{aligned}
$$
question.worked_solution:
The gradient of the product of two functions $f(x,y)$ and $h(x,y)$ is given by

$$
∇[fh]=h∇f+f∇h.
$$

Using the product rule, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}∇[f(x,y)h(x,y)] & =h(x,y)∇f(x,y)+f(x,y)∇h(x,y) \\  & =\sqrt{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}}(\frac{y}{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}}\,i-\frac{x}{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}}\,j)+\operatorname{arctan}⁡(\frac{x}{y})(\frac{x}{\sqrt{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}}}\,i+\frac{y}{\sqrt{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}}}\,j) \\  & =\frac{y\sqrt{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}}}{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}}\,i-\frac{x\sqrt{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}}}{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}}\,j+\frac{x\operatorname{arctan}⁡(\frac{x}{y})}{\sqrt{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}}}\,i+\frac{y\operatorname{arctan}⁡(\frac{x}{y})}{\sqrt{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}}}\,j \\  & =\frac{y}{\sqrt{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}}}\,i-\frac{x}{\sqrt{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}}}\,j+\frac{x\operatorname{arctan}⁡(\frac{x}{y})}{\sqrt{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}}}\,i+\frac{y\operatorname{arctan}⁡(\frac{x}{y})}{\sqrt{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}}}\,j \\  & =\frac{y+x\operatorname{arctan}⁡(\frac{x}{y})}{\sqrt{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}}}\,i+\frac{y\operatorname{arctan}⁡(\frac{x}{y})-x}{\sqrt{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}}}\,j \\  & =\frac{1}{\sqrt{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}}}((y+x\operatorname{arctan}⁡(\frac{x}{y}))i+(y\operatorname{arctan}⁡(\frac{x}{y})-x)j).\end{aligned}
$$
